system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The meteorite that birthed your clans power left behind a legacy of destruction, both of your enemies, and yourself. But you’ve learned to point and aim that destruction at things normally resilient to direct harm.

By spending 10 minutes in contact with a creature suffering from a Curse, or an object, structure or creature marked with a Complex Seal, you can feed your Star Chakra into it, weakening either, reducing the DC needed to help dispel them by 5. If you can spend at least 1 hour doing this, you can instead dispel a Complex Seal, and heavily weaken the Curse, causing it to be suppressed for the next 24 hours.
